question.text: A Merchant Banker appointed for a Cat III AIF SHALL NOT be:

answer.text: An associate of the AIF, its sponsor, manager or trustee

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 4.2.1, the Merchant Banker cannot be an associate of the AIF, its sponsor, manager or trustee (independence requirement). The Trap: First two describe the MB's role; public/private status is unrelated. Cross-Exam Context: Independence tested across all categories. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Confirm no common directors/affiliations when appointing the MB.
